games.title: 盲圖領航
games.operativeFields: Grid dimensions, actual wall/trap topology and destination; level IDs excluded.
games.alternateMethod: Safe exploratory detour with navigator signals, then route to camp

games.title: 時間搭檔
games.operativeFields: Number of gates, cycle periods, openings and offsets; decorative gate names excluded.
games.alternateMethod: One full first-shutter time cycle rewound before replanning all later phases

games.title: 巨人與小匠
games.operativeFields: Ordered gap widths, pipe-entry elevations, pipe lengths and left/right branching turns.
games.alternateMethod: Independent terrain operations performed in the opposite order

games.title: 夢境剪接師
games.operativeFields: Scrambled operative left/right port pairs, panel count and entry/exit heights; panel identity labels excluded.
games.alternateMethod: Panel swap selected from the opposite endpoint

games.title: 譯者與使節
games.operativeFields: Syntax permutation, token mapping, number of rounds, goods, quantity intervals and required tones.
games.alternateMethod: Different valid offer quantity where possible, reverse grammar-slot construction order

games.title: 醫師與奈米艇
games.operativeFields: Vessel dimensions and blocked branches, sample positions, infection/drug assignment and delivery count.
games.alternateMethod: Scan all samples first and visit infected sites in reverse order

games.title: 倒影雙生
games.operativeFields: Ordered reflective branch angles and traversal lengths; unused decorative height excluded.
games.alternateMethod: Reflection returns along its lit surface before recollecting the seal

games.title: 指揮與潛艇
games.operativeFields: Ocean dimensions, reef topology, destination and resulting echo visibility constraints.
games.alternateMethod: Echo-confirmed out-and-back exploration before destination navigation

games.title: 植物與園丁
games.operativeFields: Fruit and well arrangements, stone topology, branch targets and root-resource access.
games.alternateMethod: Grow the entire reachable root network before growing the fruit-bearing stem branches

games.title: 導演與替身
games.operativeFields: Shot count, move and camera/rig assignments, exact cue times and legal tolerances.
games.alternateMethod: Stunt performed near the leading edge of the valid timing window

games.title: 寄居堡壘
games.operativeFields: Ordered slopes, roughness, turns, segment lengths and available battery.
games.alternateMethod: Shielded low-speed driving and immediate cooling on every segment

games.title: 說書與化身
games.operativeFields: Ordered scene/rule choices, initial world conditions and scene count; AI preferred-branch field excluded.
games.alternateMethod: Other narrative branch, including different condition edits and resulting gifts

games.title: 光束接力
games.operativeFields: Board dimensions, blockers, ordered moving-target positions and wavelength sequence; actual 80-tick segments with 40 required illuminated ticks.
games.alternateMethod: Lower-source optical path and upward reflection pair instead of upper-source path

games.title: 空中吊運隊
games.operativeFields: Actual obstacle position/width/height profile, flight distance, asymmetric cargo silhouette, required dock orientation and cell-by-cell fit geometry; derived clearance indicator excluded.
games.alternateMethod: Higher flight clearance with different pendulum settling while retaining the exact irregular docking footprint

games.title: 無聲調查局
games.operativeFields: Suspect trait matrix, culprit-consistent corroborated evidence, unverified rumor, room ordering and suspect count.
games.alternateMethod: Reverse evidence-category order and reverse scene-search order
